subject: Post-call: Clarify tenancy boundaries & action items for Aurum Health POC
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@aurumhealth.com>, Jared Klein <jared.klein@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Clarify tenancy boundaries & action items for Aurum Health POC

Hi Sofia / Jared —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Short recap + items we need to unblock the POC so we can size the right deployment mode (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem). High-level takeaways I captured:

- Aurum needs inference for clinical summarization and med-triage that will touch PHI; security posture + auditability are primary constraints.
- Performance target: median 120ms token latency for typical sessions, 95th percentile < 300ms for short-turn prompts (<=512 tokens).
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~30 concurrent sessions with bursts up to 120 sessions for short windows.

Requests / clarifying questions (please confirm next week):
1) Do you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for model input encryption at rest and in transit, or is platform-managed KMS acceptable for the POC?
2) Can you share the security questionnaire PDF and the list of required evidence (SOC2 reports, infra diagrams, retention policies)? I attached a POC scope draft — please add comments.
3) For tenancy: if we propose Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) vs Private (VPC + dedicated control plane), what is the minimum procurement timeline you can accept?
4) Traffic profile: can you share sample payload sizes or a short trace (anonymized) so we can validate KV cache and batching parameters?

What we'll do on our side next:
- Neha will draft two recommended configs (Dedicated tuned for latency; Private VPC with strict tenant isolation + audit logging) and enumerate unit cost trade-offs.
- I will share a proposed POC success criteria doc and a timeline that aligns with your procurement window.

Proposed next meeting: Thu 20 Aug, 10am PT — 30 minutes to review config options and procurement steps.

Attachments: POC_scope_draft.docx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@aurumhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Jared Klein <jared.klein@aurumhealth.com>, Aurum Health Security <security@aurumhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Clarify tenancy boundaries & action items for Aurum Health POC

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers inline below and attaching our security questionnaire (Aurum_Security_Questions_v2.pdf).

1) KMS: For the initial POC we can use platform-managed KMS, but production will require customer-managed KMS (HSM preferred). Is that a hard dependency for rollout or can it be part of the production roll plan?

2) Attached security questionnaire includes a checklist of required artifacts (SOC2 type II summary, vulnerability scan results, network diagrams, key rotation policy). Our security team will want to review your audit log retention specifics.

3) Procurement timeline: ideally we need procurement sign-off within 6 weeks post-POC to meet our Q1 internal milestone. For Dedicated we'd need an MSA + SOW; for Private VPC we need a separate addendum (longer lead time due to network setup).

4) Traffic: I can export a one-day anonymized trace (size + request/response timing) — will send by Tue EOD.

We are strongly leaning toward Dedicated if latency and audit log fidelity are assured — Private may be necessary if security flags the HSM requirement.

Next call Thu 20 Aug 10am PT works for us.

Sofia Ramirez
Director of Digital Platforms | Aurum Health
sofia@aurumhealth.com

Attachment: Aurum_Security_Questions_v2.pdf

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@aurumhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Clarify tenancy boundaries & action items for Aurum Health POC

Karthik / team —

Following up with a technical note we should include in the options doc. I ran quick back-of-envelope perf estimates against Aurum's stated targets:

- Hosted API: lowest startup friction, but harder to guarantee 95th percentile latency at 120 concurrent sessions during bursts unless we reserve capacity. Noisy neighbor risk is higher; prefix/KV cache helps but multi-tenant tail latency is a concern for PHI-sensitive SLAs.

- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): Best balance — predictable p95 latency, isolated compute, and support for autoscale bursts if we provision headroom. We can enable token-level audit logs and longer retention for compliance. Cost is higher than shared hosting but lower than full Private deployment setup costs.

- Private (VPC + control plane): Maximum isolation, customer-managed VPC peering and KMS/HSM support. Longer lead time (network & VPN configuration + onboarding), and SRE involvement for on-prem options.

Specific asks for the POC configuration: please confirm the following so I can size GPU type / cluster.
1) Average tokens per session and peak token length (estimate): Aurum said ~200 tokens typical, up to 1200 for a fraction of sessions — please confirm with the trace.
2) Whether customer-managed KMS is required for POC or only for production. If required for POC, we'll need network white-listing and HSM key grant process applied.
3) Expected retention window for audit logs and where Aurum wants logs forwarded (S3 bucket vs customer SIEM).

I'll draft two config sheets (Dedicated-optimized, Private-minimal) and include a cost per 1M tokens estimate and a p95 latency projection.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@aurumhealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call: Clarify tenancy boundaries & action items for Aurum Health POC

Thanks all — perfect. Sofia, appreciate the questionnaire; we'll review and aim to return a set of answers + a minimal evidence pack by Tue 18 Aug.

Action checklist (owners):
- Aurum: send anonymized trace (Sofia) — due Tue EOD (Jared may help).
- Redwood: Neha to share Dedicated vs Private config sheets + cost/latency trade-offs (Mon COB).
- Redwood: I will circulate a one-page POC success criteria + proposed SOW language for Dedicated and Private options (Mon morning).
- Security: If Aurum requires HSM for production, mark that as a gating item for the Private rollout and note procurement lead time (~8–10 weeks).

I'll send calendar invite for the Thu 20 Aug call and include a short agenda. If anything else comes up before Tue, flag it on the thread.

—Karthik
